sentences.text: ¿Por qué tienes que destrozarte por cometer un pequeño error?

sentences.english: The war tore many families apart

sentences.text: La crisis financiera destrozó al club

sentences.text: La crisis destrozó la organización
sentences.english: The crisis tore apart the organization

sentences.text: La policía destrozó la casa
sentences.english: The police tore the house apart

sentences.english: They tore the place apart looking for the money

sentences.english: The explosion tore the building apart

sentences.text: El tornado destrozó el granero
sentences.english: The tornado tore apart the barn

sentences.text: Si sigues empujándome, ¡te voy a dar un puñetazo!
sentences.english: If you keep pushing me over, I’m going to punch you!

sentences.english: The convict pushed his buddy over the wall and followed after him

sentences.text: ¡Te reto a que me empujes por esa valla!
sentences.english: I dare you to push me over that fence!

sentences.text: Cheryl está presentando un nuevo plan para la escuela

sentences.text: Los árboles están dando nuevos brotes verdes
sentences.english: The trees are putting forth new green shoots

sentences.english: This bush puts forth new shoots each spring

sentences.english: Listen up, everyone! Today’s topic is phrasal verbs, as in to listen up

sentences.text: La película deja mucho fuera de la historia

sentences.text: Dejaste fuera las mejores partes de la historia
sentences.english: You left out the best parts of the story

sentences.text: Dejó fuera un detalle importante en su relato
sentences.english: She left out an important detail in her account

sentences.text: Siempre la dejan fuera de la conversación
sentences.english: They always leave her out of the conversation

sentences.text: Si prefiere sabores suaves, reduzca u omita la guindilla

sentences.english: We decided to leave the chapter out of the book altogether

sentences.text: Algunos cuestionarían la sabiduría de dejarla fuera del equipo
sentences.english: Some would question the wisdom of leaving her out of the team

sentences.text: Esta oración no tiene sentido; se ha omitido una palabra clave
sentences.english: This sentence doesn’t make sense; a keyword has been left out

sentences.text: ¿Todos recibieron un pedazo de pastel? No quiero dejar a nadie fuera
sentences.english: Did everyone get a piece of cake? I don’t want to leave anyone out

sentences.text: ¿Quién dejó los platos sucios en la encimera de la cocina?
sentences.english: Who left the dirty dishes out on the kitchen counter?

sentences.text: ¡No dejes tu ropa sucia en medio de la sala de estar!
sentences.english: Don’t leave your dirty clothes out in the middle of the living room!

sentences.text: Brian Graham dejó sus llaves en su escritorio mientras estaba en una reunión
sentences.english: Brian Graham left his keys out on his desk while he was in a meeting

sentences.text: Nunca, bajo ninguna circunstancia, debe dejar su billetera sobre una mesa
sentences.english: You should never, under any circumstance, leave your wallet out on a table

sentences.text: Dejé afuera al perro anoche
sentences.english: I left the dog out last night

sentences.text: Puedes dejar tu auto esta noche
sentences.english: You can leave your car out tonight

sentences.text: Oh, hombre, accidentalmente dejé el helado, ahora está todo derretido
sentences.english: Aw man, I accidentally left out the ice cream — now it’s all melted

sentences.text: Dejamos al gato afuera anoche y casi se congela hasta morir
sentences.english: We left the cat out last night and it nearly froze to death

sentences.text: No le habían invitado a la fiesta y se sentía muy excluido
sentences.english: He hadn’t been asked to the party and was feeling very left out

sentences.text: Se siente excluida porque los otros niños no juegan con ella
sentences.english: She feels left out because the other children don’t play with her

sentences.text: ¡Por supuesto que me sentí excluido cuando ustedes fueron al concierto sin mí!
sentences.english: Of course I felt left out when you guys went to the concert without me!

sentences.text: Chupe el agua en el tubo
sentences.english: Suck the water into the tube

sentences.text: Un remolino casi absorbió nuestra canoa
sentences.english: A whirlpool nearly sucked our canoe in

sentences.text: Use una aspiradora para succionar la bolsa en el tubo
sentences.english: Use a vacuum to suck the bag into the tube

sentences.english: We open our mouths to suck air into our lungs

sentences.text: El remolino succionó a los nadadores a las profundidades del río
sentences.english: The whirlpool sucked the swimmers into the depths of the river

sentences.english: Can you suck that bit of strawberry into your straw, or is it too big?

sentences.english: You’ve sucked me into this drama of yours

sentences.text: Me han convencido para que les ayude a recaudar dinero
sentences.english: They sucked me into helping them raise money

sentences.english: I got sucked into the argument because I was a friend of the family

sentences.text: Les estoy enseñando a los niños a sumar
sentences.english: I’m teaching the kids to add up

sentences.english: Earn a little money every day. It eventually adds up

sentences.english: Apparently, they’ve patched things up with their father

sentences.english: The nurses managed to patch her up temporarily

sentences.english: The nurse checked on the patients regularly

sentences.english: Still, I hope he sticks around until the final show

sentences.english: The story takes place in the 18th century

sentences.text: La próxima reunión tendrá lugar el jueves
sentences.english: The next meeting will take place on Thursday

sentences.english: Major changes are taking place in society

sentences.english: Why is the hearing taking place now?

sentences.english: When will this party take place?” “It’s taking place right now

sentences.english: Some strange things had taken place in that old castle

sentences.english: The discussion took place in a famous villa on the lake’s shore

sentences.english: She wanted Hugh’s wedding to take place quickly

sentences.text: Las elecciones tendrán lugar ahora el veinticinco de noviembre
sentences.english: Elections will now take place on November the twenty-fifth

sentences.text: Ahora se están llevando a cabo más investigaciones

sentences.text: Si el referéndum se celebra este año y es destituido, se celebrarán elecciones
sentences.english: If the referendum takes place this year and he is voted out of office, an election will be held

sentences.text: Los dos perros se enamoraron de inmediato y empezaron a jugar
sentences.english: The two dogs took to each other immediately and started to play

sentences.text: Tomé a John desde el primer día
sentences.english: I took to John from day one

sentences.text: ¿Se lo llevaron los niños?
sentences.english: Did the children take to him?

sentences.english: I’m so happy that my parents have taken to my new girlfriend

sentences.english: Recently he’s taken to wearing a cap

sentences.english: My husband has taken to gardening now that he’s retired

sentences.english: Joanne says she’s ill, and she’s taken to her bed

sentences.text: Un libro es algo que te llevas a la cama
sentences.english: A book is something you take to bed with you

sentences.text: ¿Le importaría llevarme estas cartas a la oficina de correos?
sentences.english: Would you mind taking these letters to the post office for me?

sentences.text: Llevaré a Jenny a la casa de su madre el fin de semana
sentences.english: I’m taking Jenny to her mom’s house for the weekend

sentences.text: Llévale esto a Bill para que lo firme
sentences.english: Take this to Bill so he can sign it

sentences.text: No se preocupe por la carta, estoy seguro de que aparecerá

sentences.english: I lost my wallet somewhere at home, but it should turn up eventually

sentences.text: Mucha gente asistió al evento
sentences.english: A lot of people turned up at the event

sentences.english: She turned up quite unexpectedly at my home

sentences.text: Todavía espera que surja algo que valide su punto de vista
sentences.english: He’s still hoping that something will turn up to validate his viewpoint

sentences.text: No se preocupe, problemas como este a veces surgen con equipos nuevos

sentences.english: Something always turned up to prevent their meeting

sentences.english: The police will likely turn up the heat on more investigations into his dealings

sentences.english: Their efforts to trace the woman’s whereabouts turned up nothing

sentences.english: See if you can turn up any evidence for his presence there last night

sentences.english: Did you manage to turn up a date for Friday night?

sentences.english: The proposed amendment fell through after it was rejected by Congress

sentences.english: Looking ahead, I think the company needs to develop some new services

sentences.english: It was several minutes before the applause died down

sentences.english: Those trees have reached maturity and they are ready to produce fruit

sentences.english: It hails a lot in spring

sentences.text: Para hacer el cuento corto, él se casó con su primer amor
sentences.english: To make a long story short, he married his first love

sentences.text: El primer grupo estudia en la mañana, y el segundo en la noche
sentences.english: The first group studies in the morning, the second in the evening

sentences.text: En primer lugar, la felicidad está relacionada con el dinero

sentences.text: Si estuviera de llover, él no iría
